data.long_meaning: The name Nutan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nutana’, which means ‘new’, ‘recent’, or ‘young’. In Hindu mythology, Nutan is a name given to various goddesses and deities representing new beginnings, fresh starts, and youthful energy. The name Nutan carries the meaning “New, Fresh, Young” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nutan usually hope their child will grow to embody new, fresh, young and live with faith, good character and purpose.
